info.title: Country State City API
info.description:
Geographic data API providing countries, states, cities, timezones, currencies, and phone dial codes with tiered access levels.

## Authentication
All endpoints require an API key passed via the `X-CSCAPI-KEY` header. Get your free key at [app.countrystatecity.in](https://app.countrystatecity.in).

## Pricing & Limits
The fields returned, endpoints available, and request quotas depend on your plan. See current tiers and limits at:

**[countrystatecity.in/pricing](https://countrystatecity.in/pricing)**

## Data Access Levels
Each plan includes a data access level that controls which fields are returned:

- **Basic** — Core fields: id, name, iso2, iso3, phonecode, capital, currency, coordinates, region, timezones, emoji
- **Coordinates** — Basic + extended metadata (population, tld, nationality, currency details, postal codes, etc.)
- **Full** — All fields including translations (18+ languages) and wikiDataId

Fields restricted to higher tiers are marked in each schema below.

## Feature Gating
Some endpoints require a minimum tier. Restricted endpoints return `403` with an `upgradeUrl` when accessed on a lower plan. Check the [pricing page](https://countrystatecity.in/pricing) for current feature availability.

## Rate Limiting
Requests exceeding your daily or monthly quota receive a `429` response with your current limit, period, tier, and an upgrade URL.

## Caching
All responses include `Cache-Control`, `ETag`, and `X-Cache` (HIT/MISS) headers. Use `If-None-Match` for conditional requests to receive `304 Not Modified`.

## Usage Headers
All `/v1/*` responses include usage and plan headers:
- `X-CSC-Plan` — your current tier
- `X-CSC-Daily-Used` / `X-CSC-Daily-Limit` — today's usage vs limit
- `X-CSC-Monthly-Used` / `X-CSC-Monthly-Limit` — this month's usage vs limit

Use these to monitor consumption without a separate API call.

get.description:
Returns a list of all countries. Fields returned depend on your plan's data access level.

**Availability:** All tiers

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search filter. Case-insensitive match on `name` and `native` fields. Min 2 characters. **Requires Supporter+ plan.**

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. `id` is always included. **Requires Supporter+ plan.**

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated sort tokens: `field` or `field:asc|desc`. E.g. `name:asc,population:desc`. **Requires Supporter+ plan.**

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: BCP 47 locale code (e.g. `pt-BR`) to request a localized name. Adds `localized_name` (resolved via exact locale → base language → native name → English name fallback) and `matched_locale` (which tier matched) to each result; `name` is unaffected. **Professional and Business plans only** — silently omitted (not an error) on lower tiers. A malformed value is rejected with a `400` on every tier.

parameters.name: include_translations
parameters.description: When `true`, includes the full `translations` field (JSON string keyed by language code). **Professional and Business plans only** — silently omitted (not an error) on lower tiers. Note that an explicit `fields=translations` also returns the field and takes precedence over this flag.

get.description:
Returns the canonical IANA timezone for a country, resolved via the capital city. Includes current UTC offset and DST status.

**Availability:** All plans (Community and above). Responses cached server-side for 24 hours.

parameters.name: ciso
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g., `IN`), alpha-3 (e.g., `IND`), or numeric country ID (e.g., `101`)

get.description:
Returns the canonical IANA timezone for a specific state or province within a country.

**Availability:** All plans (Community and above). Responses cached server-side for 24 hours.

parameters.name: ciso
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g., `US`), alpha-3 (e.g., `USA`), or numeric country ID

parameters.name: siso
parameters.description: State/province code in local subdivision format (e.g., `CA` for California)

get.description:
Returns the canonical IANA timezone for a specific city. The city ID is validated against the given country and state to prevent cross-jurisdiction lookups.

**Availability:** All plans (Community and above). Responses cached server-side for 24 hours.

parameters.name: ciso
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g., `US`), alpha-3, or numeric country ID

parameters.name: siso
parameters.description: State/province code (e.g., `CA`)

parameters.name: city_id
parameters.description: Numeric city ID (from the cities endpoints)

get.description:
Returns currency data for all countries. Use the optional `?code=` parameter for a reverse lookup — returns all countries using that ISO 4217 currency code.

**Availability:** Supporter+ plan required. Responses cached server-side for 24 hours.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency code to filter by (e.g., `EUR`). Returns all countries using this currency.

200.description: List of currency entries ordered by country ISO2 code

parameters.name: ciso
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g., `IN`), alpha-3 (e.g., `IND`), or numeric country ID (e.g., `101`)

get.description:
Returns international dial codes for all countries. Use the optional `?code=` parameter for a reverse lookup — returns all countries sharing a given dial code (useful for NANP `+1` territories which are grouped by area code).

**Availability:** Supporter+ plan required. Responses cached server-side for 24 hours.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Dial code to filter by. Accepts with or without `+` prefix (`+91` or `91`), 1–4 digits, leading zeros are stripped.

200.description: List of dial code entries ordered by country ISO2 code

get.description:
Returns the international dial code for a single country.

**Availability:** Supporter+ plan required. Responses cached server-side for 24 hours.

parameters.name: ciso
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g., `IN`), alpha-3 (e.g., `IND`), or numeric country ID (e.g., `101`). Case-insensitive.

get.description:
Parses an E.164-formatted phone number to identify the originating country and extract the national number. Uses a hierarchical prefix system; for NANP (`+1`) numbers, performs area-code matching to distinguish territories.

**Note:** The response echoes the phone number (`e164`) which is PII. This endpoint returns `Cache-Control: no-store` and no `ETag` header to prevent caching.

**Availability:** Supporter+ plan required.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: E.164-formatted phone number — `+` followed by 5–15 digits (e.g., `+14155552671`)

200.description: Parsed phone number with country identification

400.description: Invalid E.164 format (missing `+`, wrong digit count)

get.description:
Resolves a country record from any ISO 3166-1 identifier. Provide **exactly one** of `iso2`, `iso3`, or `numeric`; sending zero or more than one returns `400`.

**Availability:** Starter+ plan required. Responses cached server-side for 1 hour.

parameters.name: iso2
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g., `US`). Provide exactly one of `iso2`, `iso3`, or `numeric`.

parameters.name: iso3
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (e.g., `USA`). Provide exactly one of `iso2`, `iso3`, or `numeric`.

parameters.name: numeric
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric code, 1–3 digits (e.g., `840`). Provide exactly one of `iso2`, `iso3`, or `numeric`.

200.description: Country record with all ISO identifiers

400.description: Zero or multiple ISO parameters provided

get.description:
Resolves a state/province record from its ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g., `US-CA`, `IN-MH`). Case-insensitive. Falls back to the legacy `iso2` column for older entries where `iso3166_2` is null.

**Availability:** Starter+ plan required. Responses cached server-side for 1 hour.

parameters.name: iso
parameters.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g., `US-CA` or `IN-MH`). Case-insensitive.

200.description: State record with ISO identifiers and country reference

get.description:
Translates a country code between ISO 3166-1 formats: alpha-2 ↔ alpha-3 ↔ numeric. All three conversion directions are supported.

**Availability:** Starter+ plan required.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Source format

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Target format (must differ from `from`)

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The code to convert (e.g., `US` when `from=iso2`)

400.description: Mismatched `from`/`to` formats, invalid value, or `from` equals `to`

get.description:
Typo-tolerant search for cities, states, or countries. It searches English and native names, plus translations for queries of at least 3 characters. Use `locale` to add a localized display name to each result. Results are ranked by `match_score` descending.

Example: `?q=ムンバイ&type=city&locale=ja` finds Mumbai by its Japanese translation while keeping the English `name` and stable `id`.

**Availability:** Professional and Business plans. [Compare plans](https://countrystatecity.in/pricing?source=api_playground&campaign=localized_search).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query — 2 to 100 characters. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Entity type to search

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to narrow the search (e.g., `IN`). Ignored when `type=country`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–50)

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Minimum trigram similarity score (0.1–1.0). Lower values yield looser matches.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Adds `localized_name` and `matched_locale` using exact locale → base language → native name → English name fallback. The English `name` and `id` stay unchanged. **Professional and Business plans only.**

parameters.name: include_translations
parameters.description: When `true`, includes the full translation JSON string. **Professional and Business plans only.**

200.description: List of matching results ranked by similarity score

get.description:
As-you-type search for cities, states, or countries. It searches English and native names, plus translations for queries of at least 3 characters. Results rank exact matches first, then starts-with, then fuzzy matches. Each result includes a ready-to-display `label`; when `locale` is set, that label starts with the localized name.

Example: `?q=ムンバイ&type=city&locale=ja` finds Mumbai and returns a Japanese label while preserving the English `name` and stable `id`.

**Availability:** Professional and Business plans for production use; other plans can try basic autocomplete in the public playground. [Compare plans](https://countrystatecity.in/pricing?source=api_playground&campaign=localized_autocomplete).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query — 2 to 100 characters. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Entity type to search

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to narrow the search (e.g., `IN`). Invalid when `type=country` — supplying both returns a `400`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State/province ISO code to narrow a city search further (e.g., `MH`). State codes are not globally unique, so this requires `country` to also be set and is valid only when `type=city`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–50)

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Adds `localized_name` and `matched_locale`, and starts `label` with the localized name. The English `name` and `id` stay unchanged. **Professional and Business plans only.**

parameters.name: include_translations
parameters.description: When `true`, includes the full translation JSON string. **Professional and Business plans only.**

200.description: List of matching results ranked by relevance

400.description: Missing or invalid query parameter, `state` used without `country` or with a non-city type, or `country` supplied together with `type=country`

get.description:
Find the nearest cities, states, or countries to a coordinate pair. Results are sorted by `distance_km`, nearest first.

This is **not** street-address search, map-boundary containment, road distance, or travel time. It measures straight-line distance to known place points.

Example: `?lat=19.076&lng=72.878&type=city&kind=settlement` finds settlements near Mumbai.

**Availability:** Professional and Business plans for production use. Other plans can try it in the public playground. [Compare plans](https://countrystatecity.in/pricing?source=api_playground&campaign=nearby_search).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the search origin

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the search origin

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Entity type to search

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: City classification filter. Valid only when `type=city`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Invalid when `type=country`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State or province code for a city search. Requires `country` and is valid only when `type=city`.

parameters.name: min_population
parameters.description: Minimum population a result must have

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in kilometers (1–500)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results (1–100)

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Adds `localized_name` and `matched_locale` using exact locale → base language → native name → English name fallback. The English `name`, stable `id`, and distance stay unchanged. **Professional and Business plans only.**

parameters.name: include_translations
parameters.description: When `true`, includes the full translation JSON string. **Professional and Business plans only.**

200.description: Matching results sorted from nearest to farthest

400.description: Missing or invalid query parameter, or a country, state, or kind filter used with an invalid entity type

get.description:
Returns additions, removals, and updates to country, state, and city records, oldest first. Changes are retained for 90 days. Use this feed to keep a local copy in sync instead of downloading the full dataset again.

Pagination is stable: the first request fixes the result set, and every `next_page_token` continues through that same snapshot. Changes published after page one are not added to later pages; start a new request to receive them. The token also carries the original filters, is valid for 24 hours, and must be treated as opaque.

Fields inside `old_values` and `new_values` follow the caller's data access level.

**Availability:** Business plan only. [Compare plans](https://countrystatecity.in/pricing?source=api_playground&campaign=data_change_feed).

parameters.description: Return changes for a country and its states and cities. Uses an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

parameters.description: Return one kind of change

parameters.description: Maximum records per page (1–100)
